text:
nina: Hey team — quick onboarding snag. I duplicated my ramp note into Product > Onboarding but the Docs Console still shows it as "unindexed" and the auto-linking to feature pages didn't pick up. Any tips?

people-ops: welcome Nina! most common cause: missing frontmatter properties (owner, template-version) or the page visibility set to private. did you use the Ramp Note template or copy/paste blocks?

nina: i used Duplicate from the template, then moved the page into Product > Onboarding. frontmatter looks present but maybe i changed the "visibility" accidentally.

omar: two quick checks: 1) open page properties and confirm "template-version" is set (not blank). 2) check the page is under the exact path Product > Onboarding (subpages ok). the ingest lambda reads properties + path.

nina: template-version is empty 1. oops. can someone set it to "v2"? i don't have org-admin perms to edit page schema.

people-ops: we can patch it. if you post the page URL we'll set the property and re-run ingestion. alternatively run the devex-tools patch: `devex-tools notion patch-metadata --page "<page-url>" --template-version v2` (requires devex-tools access).

nina: https://redwood.notion.so/nina/Nina-Product-20260301-ramp-9a8b. pinged.

devex-bot: @people-ops started a patch job for https://redwood.notion.so/nina/Nina-Product-20260301-ramp-9a8b. status: queued.

omar: FYI we saw a weird case where Duplicate + move removed the linked-features tag, which blocked cross-search. if you notice missing tags add them back in page properties.

people-ops: patch completed 1 set template-version=v2 and visibility=Internal. re-ingest kicked off. monitor Console > Docs -> Ingests.

nina: confirmed, Console shows status = success and links populate now. thanks! one more small ask: is there a short how-to for duplicating templates without breaking automations?

omar: yes 1 we keep a 1-page guide in DevEx: DevEx > Notion > Template Duplication (short checklist). TL;DR: open template -> Duplicate -> Move into team space -> fill frontmatter (owner, template-version, linked-features, visibility) -> wait for ingest success.

nina: perfect. can someone share the guide link?

people-ops: https://redwood.notion.so/devex/Notion-Template-Duplication-Guide-3c1f. closing the loop.

nina: got it, thanks everyone 1 saved my afternoon :smile:
